values.note: 65 standard electric sites in three loops (Joan 1-20B, CVIE 21-29, Frid 30-60) plus 7 equestrian sites (61-67) by the horse corral. Water and sewer at 1-5 and 17-60; water only at 6-7; electric only at 8-16. Parking spurs listed 51-88 ft; trailers up to 50 ft.

values.note: Playgrounds, amphitheater, a fishing pond, shoreline and bike trails, an archery park, horse stalls for registered campers. Boat ramp and swimming beach at Spalding Recreation Area, 4 miles north.

values.note: The Joan and CVIE loops (sites 1-29) close in early November; the Frid loop and equestrian sites stay open to about Nov 22. Dates shift a day or two each year.

values.note: Check-in 5 p.m., check-out 4 p.m. Horse stalls are first come, first served for registered campers.

note: USACE campground on a wooded peninsula of Mark Twain Lake near Clarence Cannon Dam. Sites 40-45 at the tip sit 40-55 m above the shore through woods; the rest are back in the trees. A separate equestrian loop sits by the horse corral. --Claude
summary: rec.gov read: 72 sites (65 standard, 7 equestrian), water at 56 / sewer at 54, 50-amp per notice, $24-30, Apr 2 - Nov 22, trailers to 50 ft. Lakeview holds (no site earns lakefront). Phone 573-735-4097 to add. PIN is the facility point on Hwy J ~350 m E of the loops: move to 39.5315,-91.6510.
flags: HOOKUPS: electric 50 rests on the rec.gov notice ('Campsites 1-7 and 17-67 have 20/30/50 ampere service'); the RIDB catalog itself lists Electricity Hookup 30 on all 65 standard sites and 50 only on the 7 equestrian sites (61-67). If the catalog is held to over the notice, electric would be 50 only via the equestrian sites. The stored note's '50A on sites 30-67' matched neither and is dropped.

WATERFRONT (lakeview, kept): the catalog lists no Proximity to Water on any site. Closest sites are 40-45 at the tip of the south (Frid) loop, ~40-55 m from the shore down a wooded slope (leaf-off imagery shows the lake through the trees); 46A/46B ~70 m from the east shore; 11/12 and 26 ~70-75 m from a cove head. The ground between is undeveloped woods with no driveways or day use, but it is wooded and 40 m+, so lakefront is not earned; lakeview holds for sites 38-46B.
PIN: stored 39.5356,-91.6475 = the RIDB facility point, on Hwy J ~350 m east of the campground. Move onto the loops: 39.5315,-91.6510 (main campground road by site 21).

INCLUSION/FIT: 72 reservable electric sites, spurs 51-88 ft, trailers to 50 ft. Equestrian camping is its own 7-site loop by the horse corral, plainly separate from the three standard loops; 'No livestock permitted in campground'.
